title: Head – Talent Acquisition & Recruitment
description:
About H.R. Polycoats

H.R. Polycoats is one of India’s leading manufacturers of PU/PVC synthetic leather, technical textiles, and knitted fabrics, supplying high-performance materials at scale to global OEMs and manufacturers. Established in 1995, the company has grown steadily and expanded into a wide range of engineered materials, including non-woven products, velour, insole and cellulose boards, footwear components, and circular and warp knitted fabrics. HR Polycoats serves key industries such as automotive, footwear, furnishing, and sports/leather goods, supported by advanced manufacturing capabilities and backward integration. The organization maintains strict quality standards, holding ISO 9001:2015 and IATF 16949:2016 certifications, and offers robust in-house capabilities across R&D, design, production, digital printing, quality control, and customer support.

You can expect to work in a growth-oriented, quality-focused environment with diverse product lines and global customer reach. With a workforce of over 700 employees and expanding manufacturing and business operations, the company is focused on strengthening its organisational capabilities, building professional teams and establishing structured HR systems.

Position Overview

We are looking for an experienced and proactive Head of Talent Acquisition & Recruitment to lead the company's recruitment function.

The individual will be responsible for developing and implementing recruitment strategies, managing end-to-end hiring processes, building a strong talent pipeline and ensuring timely recruitment of suitable candidates across manufacturing, technical, managerial and corporate functions.

The role requires someone who can independently manage recruitment operations, understand workforce requirements, establish structured hiring processes and work closely with department heads and senior management.

The ideal candidate should have experience in manufacturing or industrial organisations and the ability to manage both high-volume blue-collar recruitment and specialised white-collar hiring.

Key Responsibilities1. Recruitment Strategy and Workforce Planning

* Develop and implement the company's overall recruitment strategy.
* Work with department heads and management to understand current and future manpower requirements.
* Prepare annual and periodic recruitment plans.
* Identify critical positions and develop hiring strategies for specialised and senior-level roles.
* Establish recruitment budgets, timelines and hiring priorities.
* Maintain a structured manpower requisition and approval process.

2. End-to-End Recruitment Management

* Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle, from identifying candidates to onboarding.
* Develop effective sourcing strategies through job portals, recruitment agencies, employee referrals, consultants, campus placements and professional networks.
* Screen applications, shortlist candidates and coordinate interviews.
* Conduct initial HR interviews and assess candidate suitability.
* Coordinate technical and managerial interview rounds with relevant department heads.
* Manage salary negotiations, offer approvals and offer rollouts.
* Maintain candidate databases and recruitment records.
* Ensure timely follow-ups and minimise candidate drop-offs.

3. Blue-Collar and Manufacturing Workforce Recruitment

* Develop effective recruitment channels for factory workers, operators, technicians, supervisors and other manufacturing personnel.
* Build relationships with local recruitment consultants, ITIs, vocational institutes and workforce sourcing agencies.
* Manage high-volume recruitment requirements.
* Establish a reliable pipeline for skilled, semi-skilled and unskilled manpower.
* Monitor absenteeism-related manpower requirements and coordinate replacement hiring.
* Ensure proper verification and documentation of recruited personnel.

4. White-Collar and Management Hiring

**A**
. Lead recruitment for departments including:

* Production and manufacturing
* Quality assurance and quality control
* Research and development
* Automotive division
* Sales and marketing
* Finance and accounts
* Supply chain and procurement
* Human resources
* Administration

**B.**
Handle recruitment for managerial, leadership and specialised technical positions.

**C.**
Identify suitable candidates through targeted sourcing and professional networks.

**D.**
Build talent pipelines for critical positions.

5. Recruitment Process Development and Standardisation

* Establish standard operating procedures for recruitment.
* Introduce structured interview formats and candidate evaluation scorecards.
* Develop standard job descriptions for all departments.
* Establish clear recruitment approval hierarchies.
* Implement an applicant tracking system (ATS) or suitable recruitment management software.
* Maintain recruitment trackers and management dashboards.
* Standardise candidate documentation, interview feedback and offer management.
* Develop recruitment policies and guidelines.

6. Employer Branding and Candidate Experience

* Work with the HR and brand teams to strengthen the company's employer brand.
* Improve the company's presence on LinkedIn and relevant job portals.
* Develop professional job advertisements and recruitment communication.
* Ensure a professional and timely candidate experience.
* Build relationships with educational institutions and industry networks.
* Develop employee referral programmes.

7. Recruitment Analytics and Performance Management

* Track recruitment performance through measurable KPIs.
* Monitor time-to-fill, cost-per-hire, offer acceptance rate and joining ratio.
* Analyse recruitment bottlenecks and candidate drop-offs.
* Monitor recruitment agency performance.
* Prepare weekly and monthly recruitment reports for management.
* Identify opportunities to improve recruitment efficiency and hiring quality.

8. Team Management and Stakeholder Coordination

* Build and manage the recruitment team, if any.
* Allocate hiring responsibilities and monitor individual performance.
* Guide recruitment executives and coordinators.
* Manage external recruitment agencies and consultants.
* Work closely with department heads to ensure hiring requirements are clearly defined.
* Provide regular recruitment updates to senior management.
* Ensure accountability and timely closure of open positions.

Candidate Requirements

* 8–12 years of experience in recruitment or talent acquisition, preferably with manufacturing or industrial organisations.
* Demonstrated experience managing both blue-collar and white-collar recruitment.
* Experience in bulk hiring and specialised technical recruitment.
* Proven ability to independently manage end-to-end recruitment operations.
* Experience hiring for production, quality, engineering, R&D, sales and managerial positions.
* Strong knowledge of recruitment channels, job portals and sourcing techniques.
* Experience managing recruitment agencies and consultants.
* Understanding of recruitment software and applicant tracking systems.
* Strong negotiation, communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to develop recruitment processes, policies and performance dashboards.
* Strong organisational and team leadership capabilities.

An MBA in Human Resources, postgraduate qualification in HR or equivalent professional experience would be preferred.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The individual will be evaluated on:

* Timely closure of approved vacancies.
* Quality and suitability of candidates hired.
* Time-to-fill and cost-per-hire.
* Offer acceptance and joining ratios.
* Effectiveness of blue-collar and bulk recruitment.
* Recruitment process compliance and documentation.
* Development and maintenance of a talent pipeline.
* Recruitment team productivity.
* Hiring manager satisfaction.
* Employee retention during the initial 90 days.

Reporting Structure

**Reporting to:**
Head of HR

**Department:**
Human Resources – Talent Acquisition

**Location:**
Bahadurgarh, Haryana

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

title: Human Resources Executive - Admin
description:
**Job Title: HR & Admin Executive**

**Job Overview**

The HR & Admin Executive will be responsible for managing recruitment, employee lifecycle activities, HR operations, payroll coordination, statutory records, and administrative functions. The candidate will coordinate with department heads, employees, vendors, and service providers to ensure smooth HR and administrative operations across office, warehouse, and factory environments.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Recruitment & Talent Acquisition**

* Manage end-to-end recruitment, including job postings, candidate sourcing, screening, and coordination.
* Schedule interviews, conduct follow-ups, and maintain recruitment trackers.
* Coordinate manpower requirements, job offers, and candidate closures with department heads.

**HR Operations & Employee Management**

* Maintain employee records, documentation, onboarding, and joining formalities.
* Prepare offer letters, appointment letters, and other HR-related documents.
* Coordinate attendance, leave management, employee queries, engagement initiatives, and HR policies.
* Support employee exit formalities, clearance procedures, and full-and-final settlements.

**Payroll & Compliance Coordination**

* Maintain employee attendance and leave records.
* Coordinate monthly payroll inputs and salary processing.
* Maintain records and coordinate PF, ESI, and other applicable statutory requirements.

**Office, Factory & Administration**

* Manage office and factory administration, including housekeeping, security, maintenance, and supplies.
* Coordinate with vendors, contractors, service providers, and internal teams.
* Maintain bills, invoices, assets, office records, and administrative documentation.
* Support meetings, events, and other operational requirements.

**HR Systems & Reporting**

* Maintain employee databases, recruitment trackers, attendance records, and HR MIS.
* Prepare reports related to headcount, recruitment, attendance, and employee exits.
* Maintain HR processes, checklists, and documentation.
* Identify and suggest operational improvements to streamline HR and administrative processes.

**Candidate Profile**

* 2–3 years of relevant experience in HR, recruitment, and administration.
* Experience in recruitment, onboarding, attendance, and leave management.
* Knowledge of HR documentation and payroll coordination.
* Basic understanding of PF, ESI, and applicable labour compliance.
* Proficiency in MS Office, particularly MS Excel.
* Familiarity with HR and recruitment tools.
* Strong communication, organisational, and time-management skills.
* Good problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.
* Ability to independently manage multiple HR and administrative responsibilities.

**Qualification**

* Bachelor's degree in HR, Business Administration, or a related field.

title: Plant Human Resources Manager
description:
**Note:- Please dont apply if you are from coorporate/Staffing we are looking for some who has factory or Plant experince only.**

Job Description – Factory HR Manager

Industry: Cooling Tower Manufacturing

Location: Nuh, Haryana (Onsite)

Department: Human Resources

Designation: Factory HR Manager

Experience: 8–15 Years

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced and proactive Factory HR Manager to manage the

complete HR and personnel function at our cooling tower manufacturing facility in Nuh,

Haryana. The candidate will be responsible for employee relations, industrial relations,

statutory compliance, payroll coordination, attendance and leave management, training,

and overall factory HR operations.

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in manufacturing or engineering

industries, with the ability to manage shop-floor employees, contract labour,

supervisors, and management staff while ensuring smooth factory operations and

compliance with applicable labour laws.

Required Skills

• Strong knowledge of factory HR operations and manufacturing workforce

management.

• Sound understanding of labour laws, statutory compliance, and industrial

relations.

• Excellent communication, negotiation, conflict-resolution, and problem-solving

skills.

• Ability to manage a diverse workforce and handle shop-floor employee issues

independently.

• Proficiency in MS Excel, HRMIS, attendance systems, and payroll coordination.

• Strong coordination skills with Production, Accounts, EHS, Administration, and

senior management.

• Ability to work in a factory-based environment and manage operational priorities.

Required Industry Experience

Candidates from the following industries will be required:

• Cooling Towers and Industrial Equipment Manufacturing

• Steel, Automotive, EPC, and Process Equipment Manufacturing

**JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**

• Report to the factory at least 15 minutes before the commencement of factory

operations and leave 15 minutes after factory closing time, ensuring presence

before manpower enters and after manpower exits the premises.

• Share the daily manpower strength report (as per the prescribed format) through

Email and WhatsApp before 10:30 AM every day.

• Contact employees who are absent without prior leave approval to ascertain the

reason for absence and confirm their availability for the next working day.

Similarly, coordinate with contractors to understand manpower shortages and

ensure adequate workforce deployment.

• Ensure that all files, records, registers, certificates, and documents are properly

maintained, updated, secured, and readily available for inspection at all times.

• Plan and coordinate overtime (OT) requirements with the Production and Dispatch

teams for Sundays, holidays, and other operational needs, wherever required.

• Conduct a minimum of 2 rounds daily across all shop floors and open areas to

monitor housekeeping, lighting, maintenance, employee productivity, and overall

discipline. Immediate corrective action must be taken wherever necessary.

• Handle liaison activities with government authorities and external agencies,

including Police, Labour Department, Lawyers, and other statutory bodies.

• Manage deployment of factory manpower to various project sites across India,

including manpower planning, travel arrangements, ticket bookings, and

coordination with Clients, Site In-Charges, and Head Office.

• Ensure complete security of men, material, machinery, and company assets.

Security personnel should be deployed and managed through rotational duties to

prevent theft, pilferage, and unauthorized activities.

• Ensure timely compliance with all statutory requirements related to PF, ESI,

Labour Laws, Health & Safety, Electricity, DG Sets, Environment & Pollution

Control, and other applicable regulations. Maintain all statutory records,

certificates, NOCs/NDCs, and compliance documents in updated condition.

Coordinate periodic health check-ups, X-rays, ultrasounds, and other medical

examinations as recommended by the company doctor.

• Maintain optimum manpower strength in the factory at all times. In case of

manpower shortages, suitable resources should be arranged through available

recruitment channels and sources.

• Perform duties independently and proactively, ensure proper housekeeping and

cleanliness throughout the factory premises, including internal production areas,

offices, open spaces, roads, and external surroundings of factory maintaining a

safe and hygienic working environment.

• Monitor workforce productivity to ensure employees remain engaged in assigned

tasks. Supervisors and Engineers should remain present on shop floors and work

locations where production, assembly, erection, or other operational activities are

being carried out.

• Refrain from involvement in scrap sales, material purchases, or procurement

activities unless specifically authorized by management.

• Oversee maintenance and Annual Maintenance Service (AMS) activities related to

DG Sets, drinking water systems, sewage systems, buildings, roads, open areas,

boundary walls, toilets, electrical infrastructure, fans, air conditioners, lighting,

and ventilation systems. Coordinate with the Factory Caretaker to ensure timely

completion of maintenance activities.

• Recruitment and separation of manpower shall be carried out only after obtaining

concurrence from the Production Manager and Production Coordinator, along with

written approval from the Head Office.

• Any other job as per requirement of company, jobs & responsibilities mentioned

here can be added/deleted/changed at sole discretion of management.

**Keshav Suman**

title: Officer-Talent Acquisition
description:
**About the Role:**

In this role, you will play a key part in identifying and attracting top talent to support our growth and success. You’ll work closely with hiring managers to understand their needs and provide a seamless experience for candidates, managing the recruitment process from sourcing through to offer negotiation. If you’re passionate about connecting with people, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and have a knack for spotting potential, this role offers the opportunity to build a rewarding career in talent acquisition.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Source candidates through multiple channels, including job boards, social media, and referrals
* Screen resumes and conduct initial interviews to assess candidate fit, presenting qualified candidates to hiring managers
* Work closely with hiring managers to understand their recruitment needs, helping to refine job descriptions and identify essential skills
* Provide regular updates on recruitment status and consult on hiring timelines and candidate expectations
* Address candidate inquiries promptly, providing information about the role and the organization
* Schedule and coordinate interviews between candidates and hiring managers, ensuring a smooth interview process and positive candidate experience
* Manage candidate follow-ups, feedback, and the flow of information throughout the hiring cycle
* Support offer negotiation and extension processes, handling pre-boarding documentation to ensure a seamless handover to the HR onboarding team
* Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline for critical and frequently recruited roles, identifying proactive sourcing strategies

**Key Attributes**

* Proficiency in sourcing tools
* Knowledge of LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, and various sourcing techniques
* Basic understanding of employment laws and HR practices related to recruitment

**Qualifications and Experience:**

* Education: MBA/PGDM in Human Resources (Regular).
* Experience: 5-7 years of experience in talent acquisition, preferably in a corporate or agency setting with exposure in sales hiring.

**Skills:**

* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Strong negotiation skills
